observations: Neet has a full narrow fawn trunk, fine four-legged support, broad triangular ears, projecting cream muzzle and tiny nub. Clean filled coat planes and close contours replace the engraved staging texture.

Buddy stands separately at Heather's shoes with four traceable supports, dark continuous torso, furnished muzzle/brows/ears and regional pale lower legs. Tail fringe is local, not body shag. His cautious gaze contrasts with Neet's raised-chin presentation to the poodle.

Both leads leave Heather's hand toward the respective collars; Neet's clip is visible and Buddy's upper connection is partly hidden by his head. Dry pale tiles, grooming stations, poodle and tidy towels establish arrival before the spill and mohawk. Provisional cropped human appearance does not assert likeness.

Neet crouches beneath the station with two separate forward forelegs and two flexed hind limbs attached to one torso. Table legs remain distinct from dog limbs; paws contact the floor. Nub is tiny and cream bib remains close to the chest.

His smooth tan body contains discrete droplets and suds rather than hanging fur. Buddy's elongated trunk and neck are continuous, four paws are planted across the door mat, and pale distal-leg and facial furnishings stay regional; neither torso has directional curls or raised shag.

Open doorway, broadside Buddy, spilled conditioner and displaced towel make the escape blockage readable. No mohawk appears prematurely. Neet's wary low posture and Buddy's relaxed confidence preserve the reversal, though Buddy's expression is cheerful rather than stern; this does not contradict the practical blockade.

Buddy has a continuous moderately elongated torso and neck, modest furnished head, four owned planted paws on the tabletop and visible leg clearance. The small head mohawk is episode styling. Body fields are smooth and close, with no engraved curls or raised torso shag.

Mirror contains the corresponding smiling Buddy head, pendant ears, pale muzzle and mohawk with a plausible turned reflective view; the groomer grips the handle. Neet is separately supported on four fine legs on the floor, with short smooth coat, irregular bib, triangular ears and tiny nub.

Blue towels, cream tile, warm walls and charcoal grooming table maintain salon continuity. Buddy's pleased open expression makes the earned vanity payoff distinct from arrival and blockade. Neet is dry and free of suds. The unresolved prose claim of his asymmetric long-fur trim is deliberately not promoted into anatomy.

limits: Acceptance applies only to these exact finished image hashes. Human likeness and style remain provisional. Fresh complete illustrated reading still required; this visual review does not close that stage.
